## Current research and development

### Helios

Physics-guided solar energy forecasting, uncertainty quantification and stochastic battery dispatch. In development; no operational results are claimed.

### Conjectura

Independent research initiative exploring open mathematical conjectures through AI-assisted reasoning, computational experimentation and formal verification in Lean 4. No resolved conjecture is claimed here.

## Learning and computational studies

- [Computational Mathematics](https://github.com/gustavobernardo1/computational-mathematics): numerical methods, optimization and uncertainty.
- [Scientific ML](https://github.com/gustavobernardo1/scientific-ml): inverse problems, physics-guided learning and reproducible experiments.

Both are learning workspaces; completed studies will be highlighted after review.
